summary: Iter23 E2E verification of THREE new features: (1) Backup workers (create gig w/ backup_slots, approve-as-backup, promote, remove), (2) Shift cancellation with late-flag + auto-promote, (3) Resend email notifications. All backend tests pass (6/6 in test_backups_and_cancel.py + 6/6 new in test_iter23_e2e_setup.py = 12/12). All frontend E2E flows verified in Playwright (Admin GigDetail full flow, New Gig dialog backup_slots field, Worker GigDetail cancel-shift modal, withdraw button, late-cancel warning + toast). Zero regressions in admin login, /ops/gigs list, /ops/requests queue, /crew feed. Resend is configured (key in backend/.env) and admin actions complete successfully (graceful — no exceptions in backend.err.log).
action_items: No blocking action items. Optional: server.py is now ~8300 lines — split into routers (auth/gigs/projects/va_commission/owner/backups+cancel) as called out in iter22 and in the original problem statement. This is a P1 follow-up, not blocking iter23 sign-off.

Optional: Add an explicit log line (logger.info) whenever _send_email_sync is invoked OR fails so future ops/observability can audit Resend deliverability per-event. Currently the success/failure of an email send is silent in the logs.
critical_code_review_comments: GigDetail.jsx admin flow is clean — backups-section, approve-backup, promote-backup, remove-backup all have correct data-testids and integrate end-to-end. Slot accounting (slots_filled, backups_filled, status: open/filled) updates correctly after promote.

WorkerGigDetail.jsx cancel-shift modal correctly distinguishes pending (withdraw) vs accepted (cancel-shift) state and shows the <24h warning. Toast text is excellent — distinguishes 'late' vs normal cancel and confirms HCOB notification.

RESEND_API_KEY is committed to /app/backend/.env (line 1: re_aXxSQEVk_...). This is a real API key. Consider rotating + moving to a secret manager — checked-in keys are a credential-exposure risk. Should not block iter23 but flag for security pass.

server.py monolith remains ~8300 lines. The backup_slots / cancel-shift / approve-backup / promote endpoints work correctly but are interleaved with the rest. Modularization remains overdue but not blocking.
